title: Large Retail Receipts on the OTC Allowance — Training Note with Cases
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance.** The receipt allowance charge of a posted retail register receipt starts from the register total as the large-receipt rule counts it.

**Rule.** The large-receipt rule counts a register total above seventy-five dollars ($75.00) as seventy-five dollars plus one half (0.5) of the part above seventy-five dollars where at least one retail receipt was posted on the coverage in the last six whole months, as seventy-five dollars only where a register total above seventy-five dollars comes with no retail receipt posted in the last six whole months, and as the full register total where the register total is seventy-five dollars or less.

A date falls in the last six whole months when fewer than six whole calendar months have passed from that date to today, a month counting as whole only once today's day of the month has reached that date's day of the month. Receipts counted are retail pharmacy purchases on the coverage that carry a posting date in that window.

### Counting table

| Register total | Retail receipt posted in the last six whole months | Counted total |
|---|---|---|
| Above $75.00 | At least one | $75.00 plus one half of the part above $75.00 |
| Above $75.00 | None | $75.00 |
| $75.00 or less | Either | The full register total |

### Cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Register total | Posted retail receipt in the window | Counted total |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | $95.00 | Yes | $75.00 plus $10.00, that is $85.00 |
| 2 | $95.00 | No | $75.00 |
| 3 | $75.00 | No | $75.00 |
| 4 | $60.00 | Yes | $60.00 |

Case 3 sits on the boundary: a total of exactly $75.00 is not above $75.00 and counts in full.
